title: Triggered Wildling
details: I’ve never seen a nut make someone cry. But here we have it. Protein tears are running down this pretty face, which is kind of funny as I’m sure her trailer was swept up in a storm at least thrice. She begged for it to be gone. Her only choice was to eat it. She didn’t like the options. As she sat there looking like Brandon Frasier in his prime, more whimpers emerged. We had little choice but to dump the whore bowl on her, which caused her to bolt like Usain. This was the end. I’ll let you imagine what happened throughout. Bad things man... Bad. Things
